title: ageratina oaxacana
intro: Ageratina oaxacana, commonly known as Oaxaca Mountain Mint, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is a shrubby perennial with medicinal properties, traditionally used in Mexican folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Ageratina oaxacana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
